title: Make workflow security gates diff-local for legacy debt
objective: Repair Security Actions and Security Supply Chain so unchanged historical workflow debt remains visible but does not block trigger-only edits, while every newly introduced or modified unsafe workflow line still fails closed.
non_goals: modify any historical Lot mutation workflow
pin or rewrite historical action refs as a workaround
add zizmor ignores configs or broad suppressions
change Lot45 candidate code or reviews
introduce mandatory paid or LLM-backed security review

forbidden_semantics: new dynamic or malformed uses acceptance
historical workflow job or action ref mutation

required_invariants: actionlint still lints each complete changed workflow for syntax
zizmor remains offline strict no-config with its positive control unchanged
zizmor blocks findings located on added or modified head lines and blocks findings without a concrete location
zizmor findings confined to unchanged legacy lines remain visible metadata but do not fail the changed-line gate
supply-chain changed mode evaluates only uses clauses on added or modified head lines
new floating dynamic malformed or unapproved pinned uses on changed lines fail closed
inventory mode continues to report all repository legacy action-ref debt
trigger-only deletions before unchanged uses lines do not transform legacy debt into new debt
the eight WU02 historical workflows and all protected Lot44 evidence remain untouched during WU03
business development remains paused and Lot46 remains locked
acceptance_criteria: synthetic trigger-only edit with unchanged legacy floating uses passes the diff-local gates
synthetic newly added floating uses fails supply-chain validation
synthetic changed uses to an unapproved SHA fails supply-chain validation
synthetic changed dangerous workflow line producing a zizmor finding fails
synthetic zizmor finding without a concrete location fails closed
Security Actions passes on WU03 exact head
Security Supply Chain passes on WU03 exact head
Engineering Bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on WU03 exact head
no historical mutation workflow changes occur inside WU03 scope

done_when: unchanged legacy workflow debt no longer blocks unrelated trigger-only edits
new or modified unsafe workflow lines still fail closed
both security workflows pass on the exact WU03 head without broad ignores
WU02 can be safely resumed without touching historical jobs or protected Lot44 evidence
